digest.component_or_area: testing framework / subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: Blanket module-wide autouse timeout fixture creates implicit wall-clock race in reap tests by depending on startup latency exceeding injected deadline rather than explicit ordering.

Split autouse fixture into opt-in fixtures: 0.2s call/0.1s grace/0.1s drain for hanging-child reap tests and 30s ceiling for completing-child tests to eliminate load-dependent latent flake in opposite direction.
Add explicit readiness markers to fake subprocess children so parent polls for observed file completion before deadline measurement, decoupling ordering from elapsed wall-clock time.
Reduce injected low-speed stall window from 2s to 1s in snapshot fetch test since sibling test already proves git honors 1s window.
Production timeout defaults remain unchanged at 120s call / 3s grace / 2s drain / 10s low-speed window.
All reap assertions depending on child-side setup now gated on explicit readiness instead of wall-clock ordering against interpreter startup latency.
